title: 马克·沃尔特旗下TWG回应：不存在欺诈行为
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Obviously, this is important because Mark Walters of Guggenheim has been looking at unwinding some of his balance sheets, so how do these Lebron loans factor into all of it?
segments.zh: 显然，这很重要，因为Guggenheim的Mark Walters一直在考虑缩减部分资产负债表，那么这些Lebron贷款在其中扮演什么角色？

segments.en: Sure, it might be important from that perspective and might be the reason why we stumbled across this, but more than important, I think it's really interesting. There is no sign, just to be clear,
segments.zh: 当然，从这个角度看可能很重要，也可能正是我们发现这件事的原因，但更重要的是，我觉得这真的很有趣。需要明确的是，没有任何迹象表明这与当前的上涨有关。

segments.en: there is no sign, no indication has anything to do with the current increase, but much like us in other newsrooms that have been scouring through insurance balances and trying to understand what's
segments.zh: 没有任何迹象表明这与当前的上涨有关，但就像我们和其他新闻编辑室一样，我们一直在仔细审查保险资产负债表，试图了解其中的内容。

segments.en: on there. We stumbled across this 2018 deal with Sameer Lebron signed a $154 million contract to join the Lakers. We find out it wasn't even the biggest deal of the year for him. There was
segments.zh: 我们偶然发现了2018年的一笔交易，Sameer Lebron签下了一份1.54亿美元的合同加盟湖人队。我们发现这甚至不是他当年最大的一笔交易。

segments.en: a $300 million deal structured as bonds to unlock upfront capital for him and backed by his future
segments.zh: 还有一笔3亿美元的交易，以债券形式构建，为他解锁了前期资金，并以他未来的收入流作为担保。

segments.en: revenue stream, future earnings from everything outside of basketball, for instance the Lifetime Nike sponsorship deal, which by the way, athletes, artists are increasingly starting to do that and
segments.zh: 未来收入流，即篮球之外的所有收入，比如耐克的终身赞助协议。顺便说一句，运动员和艺术家越来越多地这样做。

segments.en: doing it more often. It started with David Bowie back in the 90s, but more and more people are doing it.
segments.zh: 这始于90年代的大卫·鲍伊，但现在越来越多的人这样做。

segments.en: It's a way for ultra high-network individuals to finance themselves. It's a way for the Lebron James and Taylor Swift, so the world to get immediate liquidity. But for us, the interesting point was it also
segments.zh: 这是超高净值个人为自己融资的一种方式，也是勒布朗·詹姆斯和泰勒·斯威夫特这样的名人获得即时流动性的方式。但对我们来说，有趣的是，这也表明人寿保险不再是市场上那个无聊的角落。

segments.en: shows how life insurance is just not this boring corner of the market anymore. Increasingly, they are moving into more unusual investments as asset managers and other Wall Street power players
segments.zh: 它表明人寿保险不再是市场上那个无聊的角落。随着资产管理公司和其他华尔街巨头掌控这些**，他们越来越多地转向更不寻常的**。

segments.en: take control of these investments and move this capital into perhaps riskier, but definitely higher
segments.zh: 并将这些资本转移到可能风险更高，但肯定回报更高的领域。
